codes.name: success
codes.description: Command completed successfully and emitted an ok=true envelope.

codes.name: invalid-args
codes.description: CLI flag parsing or argument schema validation failed before command execution started.

codes.name: auth-failure
codes.description: Authentication or logged-in preconditions were not satisfied.

codes.name: browser-startup-failure
codes.description: Daemon startup, browser launch, or browser acquisition failed before command logic completed.

codes.name: selector-failure
codes.description: A required page element or UI state could not be located or interacted with.

codes.name: timeout
codes.description: The command exceeded the effective timeout budget.

codes.name: interrupted
codes.description: The command was interrupted by SIGINT, SIGTERM, or an equivalent cooperative cancellation path.

codes.name: internal-error
codes.description: An unexpected crash or unclassified internal failure occurred.
